units: <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 10:8:1">Koh. R. to X, 8</cite> <he>דכיתיה</he> (<cite ref="L00000"><he>ל</he></cite>)<he>ש׳ פלן</he> hast thou cleaned such and such a place?; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 79">Gen. R. s. 79</cite> <cite ref="U00518"><he>שוק</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 17:3">Gen. R. s. 17</cite> <he>שְׁקָקֵיה דר׳ וכ׳</he> the square in which R. J. the Galilean lived (<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 34">Lev. R. s. 34</cite> <he>שכונתיה</he>); a. fr.—Pl. <he>שְׁקָקַיָּא</he>, <he>שְׁקָקֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 1:20">Targ. Prov. I, 20</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 7:12">Ib. VII, 12</cite>; a. e.—Gen. R. l. c. <he>מחזרא ליה על ש׳ דקרתא</he> she led him around (begging) to all the places of the city.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 9:2:3">Y. Ber. IX, 13ᶜ</cite> <he>חכים אנא בש׳ שמיא כש׳ וכ׳</he> I know the streets of heaven as well as the streets of Nehardea (v. <cite ref="U00123"><he>שְׁבִילָא</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 44:12">Gen. R. s. 44</cite> <he>אחוי ליה שׁוֹקְקֵי שמיא</he> he showed him (Abraham) the streets of heaven; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 76:10">Yalk. ib. 76</cite> <he>שקקי שמ׳</he> (not <he>שקקי׳</he>).
